items.q: How do I choose the right activated carbon?
items.a: It depends on the contaminant, the medium (liquid or gas), flow rate and contact time. Share your process details and our engineers will recommend a grade, particle size and activity level.

items.q: What is the difference between Powdered vs Granular carbon?
items.a: Powdered carbon (PAC) is dosed directly and removed by filtration, ideal for batch or seasonal treatment. Granular carbon (GAC) is used in fixed beds for continuous treatment and can be regenerated.

items.q: Why choose coconut shell activated carbon?
items.a: Coconut shell carbon has a high share of micropores, excellent hardness and low ash, giving strong adsorption of small molecules and long service life. It is also made from a renewable raw material.

items.q: What is activated carbon used for?
items.a: Water and wastewater treatment, air and gas purification, gold recovery, oil & gas processing, and food & beverage purification, among many other applications.
